title: DepMap cancer dependency/cell-line context track pack (per-source gate required)
context: DepMap (the Cancer Dependency Map) provides cell-line dependency and CRISPR-screen data, with some datasets released under CC-BY and others under more restricted terms. This is a Priority-B source: redistribution rights for derivative tracks must be verified per-dataset before any pack is built. The catalog-014 triage resolves which DepMap datasets are APPROVED. A DepMap dependency track provides research context (which cancer cell lines depend on a gene) but is not a direct cancer variant annotation — it adds a functional genomics layer.
objective: Verify redistribution rights for a specific DepMap dataset through catalog-014, run the licensegate-002 gate, and if APPROVED, deliver a DepMap cancer dependency context track on hg38.
acceptanceCriteria: A specific DepMap dataset is confirmed APPROVED in catalog-014 with cited redistribution terms (CC-BY or verified equivalent) and permitsRedistribution: true (or marked EXCLUDED if terms cannot be confirmed).
licensegate-002 and coordgate-003 PASS artifacts committed; re-identification check PASS recorded (cell-line aggregate data confirmed).
If gate FAILS, task is EXCLUDED with the reason documented and no track is built.

If gate PASSES: all three browser targets emitted and render-verified; per-feature provenance records DepMap gene IDs, dataset version, and license; provenance completeness ≥ 90/100; not-medical-advice notice present.
output: output/packs/depmap-dependency-hg38/ — track files, browser configs, gate artifacts, manifest, and outcomes/ds-depmap-013.json (or EXCLUDED record if gate fails).
